gb-4gpu-cfg-ulysses-speed.description: GB200/GB300: the 4-GPU CFG-parallel + Ulysses-2 command, fully resident in explicit speed mode.
gb-4gpu-cfg-ulysses-speed.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --attention-backend fa --cfg-parallel-size 2 --ulysses-degree 2 --dit-layerwise-offload false --performance-mode speed --enable-torch-compile false
gb-4gpu-cfg-ulysses-speed.notes: 2026-10-10, 4x GB300, sglang 3831e7e09: under the default performance_mode=auto, server warmup runs the auto residency probe (1024x1024x81f); after it, gpu_worker._release_warmup_pool drops the IPC/Ulysses all-to-all staging buffers and calls torch.cuda.empty_cache(), which raised RuntimeError 'std::get: wrong index for variant' / 'bad optional access' on some ranks. The ranks diverged and the next ALLTOALL hung until the NCCL watchdog took the server down (health check never passed in 2400 s). Explicit speed mode skips the probe (auto_residency_args_skip_reason) and places what auto chooses on a 288 GB GPU anyway: every component resident. Same command as this model's I2V default. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round). 2026-10-22: extended to b300, the same Blackwell Ultra GPU (sm103) as GB300 on an x86 host; the GB300 measurement is the evidence, and the 4xB300 round re-measures it. 4xB300 A/B 2026-10-22: 26.34 s against default 25.39 s (one round), so B300 runs default.

default.description: Cosmos3 Nano T2V profile for SGLang-Diffusion main 3d540563.
default.notes: 4-GPU CFG parallel plus Ulysses SP for long-video H200 serving; guardrails disabled, no cache. FOUR-GPU CELLS ON THE 2026-09-13 4xB200 RUN ARE 3-4x SLOW AND IT IS NOT SGLANG. All three 4-GPU cases (this one, cosmos3 t2v 189f, cosmos3 i2v 189f) came out 3-4x slower than the SAME case and workload on H100 (07-03, 07-30) and H200 (08-26), three runs that agree with each other inside 2%. Every framework in those cells moved together -- sglang 0.25-0.32x, vLLM-Omni 0.28-0.30x, LightX2V 0.22x -- so the earlier note here calling it a suspected sglang regression was wrong, and is retracted. Nor is it the box: every 2-GPU case in that same run is 1.7-2.6x FASTER than its H200 figure. The discriminator is GPU COUNT, not model and not framework; the original investigation missed it because every image case is 2-GPU. Already eliminated, do not repeat: model unchanged since 2025-08-09, workload identical in both artifacts, warmup scales linearly, attention backend (`fa` is WORSE than the auto-selected dynamic_cudnn_sdpa), interconnect topology (NV18 all-pairs at 53.125 GB/s), offload off with 113 GiB free, MoE boundary 0.875 with both experts resident. SETTLED: a fresh 4xB200 does NOT reproduce it. MEASURED 2026-09-18 on a fresh 4xB200 (verda-b200-fin-03-3, same node family, sglang v0.5.20, cosmos3 t2v 189f, identical workload and the same `--attention-backend fa`): 2 GPU on cards 0,1 = 58.05s; 2 GPU on cards 2,3 = 58.24s; 4 GPU = 32.34s. Four-GPU scaling is healthy (1.80x over two), and the 4-GPU figure is 1.64x faster than H200's 53.09s -- the normal Blackwell gain. bench-0912 reported 214.90s for that same cell, 6.6x the healthy number. So the hardware is fine and these three cells are ARTIFACTS OF THAT BOX, not Blackwell and not sglang -- which is also the only account consistent with vLLM-Omni and LightX2V being equally slow there. Two further hypotheses died in the same experiment: `fa` is not pathological on Blackwell (arm A pins it and is 1.9x faster than H200), and the NUMA split that puts GPU3 on a different socket costs nothing measurable (58.05 vs 58.24 across it). RE-MEASURED 2026-09-18 and republished: cosmos3 t2v 214.9 -> 31.7, i2v 216.0 -> 31.9, wan22 669.4 -> 106.5, each now 1.68-1.98x faster than its H200 figure, in line with every 2-GPU cell. The two cosmos3 cells ran against Cosmos3-Nano e59a53c25 rather than the 7a312c868 the rest of the artifact records -- the shared cache resolves `main` online, so the revision could not be pinned; both cells reproduce under 0.1% across two runs and vLLM-Omni moved by the same factor, so the revision does not carry the result.

cand-noexp.description: Plain CUDA allocator segments, so the copy-engine IPC all-to-all can start. Never selected on its own: A/B arm.
cand-noexp.notes: Derived from `default` (the profile B300 selects). Audit 2026-10-23 (Cosmos3/Wan2.2 finding 1): the harness exports PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True (scripts/devbox_run_cases.sh); sharing an expandable segment needs pidfd_getfd, which RunPod containers deny, so every sglang SP cell of the round logged 'IPC all-to-all (multi-rank) unavailable (pidfd_getfd: Operation not permitted); using NCCL'. TRT-LLM already carries this override for the same reason. Accept the arm only if that line is absent. VALIDATION PENDING (wave 4, 4xB300).

cand-kvg.description: K/V-gather sequence parallel 2 in place of Ulysses 2. Never selected on its own: A/B arm.
cand-kvg.notes: Derived from `default` (the profile B300 selects). Audit 2026-10-23 (Cosmos3/Wan2.2 finding 2): the pinned --ulysses-degree 2 overrides sglang's own 4-GPU cfg2 x sp2 default, kv_gather_degree=2 (server_args: 'sp_degree=2 defaults to kv_gather_degree=2 (its measured-win zone)'); dropping the pin alone selects it, the explicit flag records it. On 2xH200 K/V-gather beat Ulysses over NCCL by 3.7-13.7% with identical output (sglang#32667). Layers the gather path cannot take fall back to Ulysses. VALIDATION PENDING (wave 4, 4xB300).

blackwell-cudnn.description: Blackwell vLLM-Omni profile for cosmos3_nano_t2v_720p_189f using cuDNN attention.
blackwell-cudnn.notes: Blackwell attention choice, measured on this box 2026-09-12. FLASH_ATTN is a Hopper-only precompiled kernel -- vLLM-Omni refuses it on sm_100 with 'FLASH_ATTN was explicitly selected but is unsupported'. FLASHINFER_ATTN starts but dies under torch.compile on dynamic shapes (`AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError: SymNodeVariable() is not a constant` in the FlashInfer backend's _ensure_plan), observed on qwen-image and cosmos3 t2v; it is fine for the static image cases (zimage, flux), which are deliberately left on it. CUDNN_ATTN is exact softmax, the same precision class as the kernels the other frameworks run here, measured at 2.741s on qwen-image (vs TRTLLM_ATTN 3.274s) and already the backend minimax-h3 serves with on this box.

blackwell-cfg2-sp2-sdpa.notes: Onboarded 2026-10-23 from the audits (image finding 3, Cosmos3/Wan2.2 finding 6): LightX2V 19c19614 has RUNNER_REGISTER('cosmos3') with tasks t2i/t2v/i2v (lightx2v/models/runners/cosmos3/cosmos3_runner.py) and configs/cosmos3/cosmos3_nano_omni.json matches this case: 35 steps (the harness writes infer_steps from the case), sample_guide_scale 6.0, sample_shift 10, 720x1280, resolution and duration templates off, one-pass norms, cosmos3_rope; offload off. Attention: torch_sdpa, LightX2V's own default for Cosmos3 (transformer_weights.py) and cuDNN / flash SDPA on B300; the upstream configs name flash_attn3 (Hopper-only) or flash_attn2 (the sm80 path). Every attention call is one sequence (_infer_attn passes a single cu_seqlens segment), so torch_sdpa ignoring cu_seqlens is exact. Text is tokenized to its real length (no padding), as in the other rows. Compile: Cosmos3TransformerInfer never calls init_compile/run_block at 19c19614, so use_compile is ignored and the transformer runs eager, LightX2V's only path. The negative prompt comes from the request (the case's), as for the other rows. VALIDATION PENDING (wave 4, 4xB300). First measured by the wave-4 A/B (scripts/run_b300_ab_20261022.sh, WAVE=4).

default.description: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen, NVIDIA's official cosmos3-super-4gpu.yaml at BF16, 4 GPU(s).
default.notes: The official 4-GPU Cosmos3 layout (CFG 2 x Ulysses 2, parallel VAE 4); Cosmos3 is VANILLA-only per the docs; CUDA graphs off (no official Cosmos3 config enables them). --visual_gen_args forces the VisualGen path: without it 1.4.0rc1 treats the cosmos3_omni checkpoint as an LLM (the 1.3.0rc26 startup hang). flow_shift moves into extra_params, max_sequence_length is top-level, guardrails off; UniPC, 35 steps = 35 evaluations. VANILLA attention is torch SDPA (FlashAttention on Hopper); no cache_config or quant_config, so the row is BF16 and cache-free; compile at the case shape so the first request does not recompile; JSON to /v1/videos/sync (or /v1/images/generations), whose reply is the media itself. The YAML is passed with --visual_gen_args (trtllm-serve has no --extra_visual_gen_options). VALIDATION PENDING (round 2026-10-22, 2xH200/4xH200).

cand-cudnn.description: cuDNN fused SDPA attention. Never selected on its own: A/B arm.
cand-cudnn.notes: Derived from `default` (the profile B300 selects). Audit 2026-10-23 (Cosmos3/Wan2.2 finding 4; Cosmos3 T2I sub-audit): only VANILLA and FA4 were A/B'd; TRT-LLM 1.4.0rc1 AttentionConfig.backend also takes CUDNN, TRTLLM, CUTEDSL and FLASHINFER (tensorrt_llm/visual_gen/args.py). Everything else is the selected visual_gen_args. No CUTEDSL arm on this cell: under Ulysses 2 Cosmos3's cross-attention refuses it ('Cosmos3 cross-attention with Ulysses cannot use the CUTEDSL backend', transformer_cosmos3.py). The cuDNN backend raises on a key_padding_mask rather than dropping it. VALIDATION PENDING (wave 4, 4xB300).

trtllm-visual.extra_env_reason: The harness exports PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True. Under it, the CUDA IPC handle TRT-LLM's rank 0 hands its media over with needs pidfd_getfd in the server process, which RunPod containers deny: every request logged 'pidfd_getfd: Operation not permitted' and hung to the read timeout (4xB300, 2026-10-22). Plain segments use cudaIpcMemHandle instead.
